recommendations: 0.064/0.066 and 0.252 measure fundamentally different things and must NOT be directly compared
0.252 (Mode B full-trajectory MAE) is the more rigorous and comparable metric
0.064/0.066 (phi-only endpoint error) is an optimistic metric that ignores 3 of 4 state channels
